optimizedDescription.value: Change: central aggregate for spec work; immutable identity, event-sourced lifecycle, artifacts, approval/verification projections, implementation tracking, sovereign schema.

optimizedContext.value:
# Change

## Rules
- Identity: unique slug `name` + `createdAt`, immutable. Reject Windows device names (`con prn aux nul com1-9 lpt1-9`, case-insens, whole slug only; `con-foo` ok). `updatedAt` >= `createdAt`, defaults `createdAt`; `touchUpdatedAt(at=new Date())`.
- `ActorIdentity`: `name`, `email`, optional `provider`/`providerId`/`metadata`. `SYSTEM_ACTOR` = `{name:'specd',email:'system@getspecd.dev',provider:'system'}`.
- Scope: `specIds` (may be empty), `workspaces` computed via `parseSpecId()` never persisted, never primary/home (no `workspaces[0]`), `specDependsOn` per-spec (top priority for `CompileContext`, no approval invalidation). Workspaces validated vs `specd.yaml` at creation; spec paths need not exist. Scope mutable; active edits go through canonical reconciliation; set add/remove makes spec consent stale w/ diffs; reorder/dupes no invalidation; no unconditional return to `designing`. Replacement drops `specDependsOn` keys not in `specIds`. Legacy `updateSpecIds` may record `spec-change` review evidence only.
- Lifecycle: `drafting → designing → ready → implementing ⇄ verifying → done → archivable → archiving`. Gates `approvals.spec`/`approvals.signoff` default `false`; when on, change stays in `ready`/`done` until `ApproveSpec`/`ApproveSignoff`. `pending-spec-approval`, `spec-approved`, `pending-signoff`, `signed-off` = drain-only valid states; new transitions MUST NOT enter `pending-*`.
- `VALID_TRANSITIONS`: `ready` → `implementing|designing` only. `done` → `archivable|designing|implementing|verifying`. Backward retry hops: `done|signed-off|archivable → implementing|verifying`. Drain: `pending-spec-approval → spec-approved|designing`; `pending-signoff → signed-off|designing`. Entity rejects unlisted pairs. Every state except `drafting` may → `designing`.
- `implementing → verifying` only when tasks complete (`workflow.taskCompletion`, see `core:transition-checks`). `verifying → implementing` only impl-only failure; artifact revision/new tasks → `designing`. Loop repeatable.
- `designing → designing`: app-level neutral no-op (no `transitioned` event, no downgrade/invalidation); entity still rejects real self-transition. `verifying → verifying` invalid, never required.
- Return to `designing` != drift; means artifacts need review.
- Backward hops = retry not redesign: no artifact mass-invalidation, invalidate active signoff, not spec approval unless files change.
- `archiving` targets: `archivable` (auto after failed commit + successful batch restore, or pre-commit guard failure), `designing` (manual escape, incl. restore failure), `done` (only central reconciler atomic mandatory signoff recovery). Others (`implementing`, `verifying`, ...) throw `InvalidStateTransitionError`. `archivable → done`/`signed-off → done` only via reconciler; callers MUST NOT synthesize.
- `verifying → done` requires already-completed current verification via registered predicate; MUST NOT complete attempt. Lifecycle movement alone preserves unchanged evidence. Fingerprint mismatch alone permits new explicit attempt, no rollback. `workflow: preserve` may retain phase absent mandatory gate recovery; non-task drift blocks forward progress. Stale required spec consent → `designing`. Stale verification: contextual before `verifying`, fresh attempt needed in `verifying`, blocks `done`/archive.
- Impl tracking persisted separate from artifacts: `trackedImplementationFiles` (state `open|resolved|ignored|removed`), `implementationLinks` (`spec -> file`, optional `-> symbols`). `removed` stays in history, not manually reopened via `resolve`; returns `open` only when refresh finds file. Link paths project-relative while active; canonical `workspace:path` at archive. Explicit vs container-only file links preserved: removing last symbol of container-only set may remove set; explicit file link preserved.
- Activation: `implementationTrackingStartedAt: Date|null`, `isImplementationTrackingActive`, `startImplementationTracking(at?)` idempotent (keeps first timestamp).
- Historical impl guard: entity exposes ever-entered-`implementing` (scan history for `transitioned` `to: implementing`); true even after return to other states. Entity does no detection.
- Spec gate (`approvals.spec: true`): forward from `ready` needs projection `valid` for current canonical `specIds` + non-task artifact fingerprint. Granted only in `ready` after validation, review, no drift/pending review. `TransitionChange` never parks. Disabled: predicate skips, freshness still applies.
- Signoff gate (`approvals.signoff: true`): `done → archivable` needs signoff `valid` for non-task artifacts + impl files, plus valid verification if required. Granted only in `done`. Disabled: predicate skips; verification, freshness, tasks, archive checks still apply.
- Projections (v2): optional current spec approval, signoff, verification; status `valid|stale|revoked`, actor, reason, timestamp, invalidation cause. Spec approval fingerprint = canonical `specIds` + artifact fingerprint; signoff = artifact + impl fingerprints. Legacy missing snapshots = unknown evidence, never fabricated. Absence = never approved. Invalidate/renew appends event, updates projection, keeps earlier events. Once `stale`/`revoked`, hash equality MUST NOT restore `valid`.
- Verification projection: active attempt baseline vs completed record. Start captures non-task artifact + resolved impl fingerprints from any active state. Completion succeeds only if inputs match baseline; persists `valid` with actor/timestamp. Later drift/invalidation → `stale`; revalidating/restoring bytes doesn't heal. Lifecycle movement alone doesn't capture/complete/invalidate.
- `StartVerification.execute({name})`: any active state; refreshes tracking/links, runs `impl.filesResolved` + `impl.linksInScope` before baseline; missing/unreadable inputs fail; appends `verification-attempt-started` (actor, time, state, attempt id, fingerprint algorithm); restart supersedes active attempt, keeps history; never records success. Resolves schema via shared change-schema boundary (sovereign; workspace default irrelevant; resolution errors propagate, no attempt created). `StartVerificationDeps` includes schema provider.
- `CompleteVerification.execute({name})`: needs active attempt, fresh inputs, shared fingerprint-validity evaluator vs baseline. Missing attempt/unresolvable inputs/changed fingerprints fail w/o replacing baseline. Success atomically records verification + append-only completion event; declaration only, runs no tests. Both delegate validity/gate recovery to central reconciler, no lifecycle transition. Both: typed input/result/deps, `createX(deps)` + `createX(config, options?)`, `resolveXDeps(resolver)`, composition normalization + invalid-factory-arguments contract. Domain free of I/O.
- Withdrawal appends `verification-invalidated` (actor, time, reason, completed id), keeps original fingerprint.
- Verification requirement by topology: `isWorkflowStepEnabled('verifying', schema)` true → required at `verifying` and later (`done`, `pending-signoff`, `signed-off`, `archivable`, `archiving`). Disabled → never required: reconciler projects `not-required` when no evidence, no `VERIFICATION_REQUIRED|VERIFICATION_IN_PROGRESS|VERIFICATION_STALE` blockers; `verification.current` (transition/archive) and `approval.signoff` treat as not required. Schema via `ResolveChangeSchema`.
- Artifacts: `ChangeArtifact` owns `ArtifactFile` map. Persistable file states: `missing|in-progress|complete|skipped|pending-review|drifted-pending-review`. `pending-parent-artifact-review` verdict-derived only (`projectArtifacts`/`evaluateLifecycleVerdict`); `ArtifactFile` rejects it in memory; load/save coerces to `in-progress`; aggregate never stores it. `validatedHash` = drift/approval baseline, not status source.
- Aggregate `state` (persisted): `drifted-pending-review` if any file so; else `pending-review` if any; `complete` if all `complete|skipped` and ≥1 file; `skipped` if all skipped; `missing` if all missing/no files; else `in-progress`. `skipped` only `optional: true` (else throws), set explicitly by actor via CLI (schema instruction/skill tells agent; command in CLI spec).
- `ChangeArtifact.markComplete(key, hash)` → `ArtifactFile.markComplete(hash)`, sets `complete`, updates `validatedHash`, recomputes state; `markSkipped()` skips ALL files. Only `ValidateArtifacts` / skip use case may call. Only `complete|skipped` satisfy `requires` at persist; verdict may show `pending-parent-artifact-review` when blocked by `pending-review|drifted-pending-review` parent.
- Invalidation: drifted files keep `hasDrift` + review evidence; extra reopening per `invalidation.artifacts`; lifecycle per reconciler. Task artifacts excluded from auto drift/parent propagation.
- `syncArtifacts(artifactTypes)`: types from `change.schemaName` via `ResolveChangeSchema`, never workspace default. Adds types/files, removes stale types/files per specIds; returns `true` if changed; appends `ArtifactsSyncedEvent` with `SYSTEM_ACTOR`.
- History: append-only `history`, events never modified/removed. State = `to` of latest `transitioned` (none → `drafting`). Drafted iff latest `drafted|restored` is `drafted` (under `drafts/`; else `changes/`). Common fields: `type`, `at` (ISO 8601), `by` (`ActorIdentity`, mandatory). Manifest JSON per `core:change-manifest`. Validity read from projections; audit events retained; broad later events MUST NOT erase unrelated evidence.
- Events: `created`(`specIds`,`schemaName`,`schemaVersion`), `transitioned`(`from`,`to`), `spec-approved`/`signed-off`(`reason`,`artifactHashes`; legacy hash-only), `invalidated`(`cause`,`message`,`affectedArtifacts`), `drafted`(`reason?`), `restored`, `artifact-skipped`(`artifactId`,`reason?`), `artifacts-synced`(`typesAdded`,`typesRemoved`,`filesAdded`,`filesRemoved`), `description-updated`(`description`), `discarded`(`reason`,`supersededBy?`), `archive-failed`, `approval-invalidated`. New v2 approvals carry projection fingerprints. Scope reconciliation records `approval-invalidated` cause `scope-change` + `spec-added|spec-removed` diffs; no broad `invalidated` required.
- `invalidated.cause`: `spec-change` (artifact-review evidence, not approval clear/rollback), `artifact-drift`, `artifact-review-required`, `spec-overlap-conflict` (archived overlapping change with `spec.overlap` bypassed). `message` human-readable; `affectedArtifacts` = list of `{type, files}` (file key for `scope: change`, spec ID for `scope: spec`). Drift invalidation captures full affected file set in one event. Overlap conflict: one focused event naming archiver + overlapping spec IDs; reopening per policy; idempotent, no duplicates.
- Archive outcome: `archive-failed` captures `step` (`prepare|commit|archive`), `message`, `commitStarted`; diagnostics only. Pre-commit failure → stay `archivable`. Commit failure → batch restore; success → `archiving → archivable`; restore failure → stay `archiving` until manual `designing`. After successful archive move: no rollback; metadata-generation/post-archive hook failures don't undo. Success recorded in archived record/manifest, not active history.
- Schema identity: `schemaName`/`schemaVersion` top-level, source of truth (decoupled from `created` event). Every op on active/drafted/discarded/archived change resolves recorded schema via `ResolveChangeSchema`; workspace default MUST NOT reject, replace identity, or be fallback. Provider identity mismatch → throw `SchemaProviderIdentityMismatchError` before use. `schemaVersion` mismatch advisory: `ResolveChangeSchema` returns typed warning vs sovereign lookup; no other component compares; change usable, archiving allowed.
- Draft/restore/discard: moves don't alter lifecycle state; recorded as events. Draft (`changes/→drafts/`, `drafted`, optional `reason`) fails by default if ever `implementing`. Restore (`drafts/→changes/`, `restored`) only `RestoreChange` via `mutateDraft`. Discard (`changes/|drafts/ → discarded/`, `discarded`, mandatory `reason`, optional `supersededBy`) fails by default if ever `implementing`. All need `by`, `at`.
- Drafted (`isDrafted === true`) read-only: no `transitioned`, validation outcomes, scope edits, approvals, invalidations, tracking updates, or artifact writes. Only Restore/Discard (`mutateDraft`). Inspect via `ChangeRepository.getDraft`/`GetDraft` returning `DraftedChangeView`. Transform via active API → `ChangeNotFoundError` (active-only resolution) or `DraftedChangeReadOnlyError` (low-level primitive).
- Interpretation authority: entity owns persisted facts only (history, state, files, aggregate states, approvals, invalidations). DAG/`requires`/parent blocking/gate checks/hop availability interpreted by `evaluateLifecycleVerdict`/`projectArtifacts` (`VALID_TRANSITIONS` = protocol-legal; `availableTransitions` = passing blockers; `evaluateLifecycle` attaches `nextAction.command`). Schema `workflow[]` lookup rows ≠ participating states.
- `Change.invalidate()`: structured policy `artifacts` + `workflow`, cause, message, focused `affectedArtifacts`, schema `ArtifactDag`. `invalidation.artifacts`: `none` (reopen nothing; drift/review still blocks), `surgical` (affected set), `downstream` (+DAG descendants), `global` (all non-task files). `hasTasks: true` excluded from drift reopening/propagation; explicit task review allowed. `invalidation.workflow`: `preserve` keeps state, `redesign` requests `designing`. Aggregate MUST NOT infer gate recovery; central reconciler decides: stale required spec → `designing`, stale required signoff → later state to `done`, spec priority if both; never advance change already earlier than target. Idempotent; audit not rewritten.
- Per-file `hasDrift` boolean persisted with state + `validatedHash`; true = content changed or absent. `invalidate()` sets `hasDrift=true` only for cause `artifact-drift` and focused files; `artifact-review-required` neither sets nor clears. `complete`+drift may render `complete-with-drift`; `missing` stays canonical.
- Task completion required only for artifact types with `hasTasks: true` + task-completion check; never inferred for other artifacts.
- Fingerprints: scope-aware, `artifacts` (path → SHA-256, excludes `hasTasks`) + `implementation` (linked path → normalized hash; none → `{}`). POSIX repo-relative keys, order-independent; add/remove/rename/unlink changes it. `{}` valid snapshot; missing/`null` = legacy unknown. `text-v1`: strip initial UTF-8 BOM, CRLF/CR→LF, strip trailing horizontal whitespace, whitespace-only lines → empty, normalize final newline; no parsing, formatting, internal-whitespace stripping, symbol-range hashing. Binary hashed byte-for-byte w/ algorithm recorded. Missing/unreadable linked files fail calc (not omitted). `hasTasks` artifacts stay required/validated/live-counted/rechecked pre-archive. Calc failure returns `null` + records input failures; invalidates evidence, no unconditional blocker; fingerprint-requiring checks enforce directly.
- Sovereign fingerprint schema: all fingerprints for existing change use shared change-schema boundary; type set, task exclusions, file selection from `change.schemaName` only. Workspace default MUST NOT influence approval/verification/signoff/archive/reconciliation. Resolution errors propagate; no default retry.

## Constraints
- `name`, `createdAt` immutable; `workspaces` derived, never persisted.
- State derived from append-only history; validity from materialized projections; audit events never erased.
- Scope/artifact changes append focused invalidation evidence, applied by central reconciler; recovery per workflow policy + gate precedence, never unconditional return to `designing`.
- `designing → designing` no invalidation/reopen.
- File state explicit, aggregated into `ChangeArtifact`; `validatedHash` = last structural baseline; `hasDrift` independent.
- `skipped` only optional artifacts; satisfies dependencies.
- Reopening policy-driven; `verifying → implementing` no mass-reopen, no invalidating unchanged verification/spec approval; below-signoff movement keeps signoff invalidation.
- `markComplete` reserved for validation, `markSkipped` for skip use case.
- `syncArtifacts` reconciles shape, appends actor-attributed event on change.
- `archivable`, `archiving` only archive source states; archive = shared transition checks, not normal edge.
- Approval gates default off; enabled: spec consent before implementation, signoff consent before `archivable`.
- Task completion via schema `hasTasks`, `taskCompletionCheck`, workflow `requiresTaskCompletion`; task content not approval evidence.
